description: Main window: API calls to the user's own server through beacon_fetch only (Rust HTTP client with TLS public-key pinning for the official Beacon host, docs/PINNING.md; HTTPS, or loopback for development; no HTTP plugin), and the app's own commands (keychain, tray, updater, heartbeat, notifications, the prompt window, links through open_external in the browser chosen with set_browser / pick_browser (the custom-browser file dialog is opened from Rust, so the webview has no dialog permission), writing copied links to the clipboard); the main window may resize and move itself ("Compact view" / "Full view"). Each app command is declared in build.rs and granted here per window.
